description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'BaseAuthenticationService' for implementing an authentication service within a Vert.x environment. It manages message consumption from the event bus, delegating authentication handling to subclasses, and provides lifecycle hooks for startup and shutdown.

classes.name: BaseAuthenticationService
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational functionality for an authentication service in Vert.x, including message handling and lifecycle management.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service by registering the event bus consumer for authentication requests and calls subclass-specific startup routines.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform additional startup actions; completes the start future.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cleans up resources by unregistering the message consumer and calling subclass shutdown routines.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform additional shutdown actions; completes the stop future.

methods.name: processMessage
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving an authentication request message; delegates to credential validation and replies back or fails accordingly.
